title: SPIN: Image Immunization Against Diffusion Editing via Single-Step Projection in Stochastic Neighborhoods
title_zh: SPIN：通过随机邻域中的单步投影实现图像对扩散编辑的免疫

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have greatly advanced instruction-guided image editing, while also raising concerns about unauthorized image manipulation. Image immunization addresses this risk by adding imperceptible perturbations to an input image to disrupt subsequent edits. Since editing requests are unknown at image release, protection should remain effective beyond the instruction used to construct the perturbation. Existing immunization methods either require costly full-trajectory backpropagation or use intermediate objectives whose effects may be weakened by subsequent denoising. Meanwhile, a single inference path provides limited feedback about alternative denoising continuations. To address these challenges, we propose SPIN , a framework for image immunization via one-step projection over local stochastic trajectory neighborhoods. Starting from an early denoising state, SPIN generates stochastic neighboring states under the same instruction and predicts their clean latents through one-step projection without full unrolling. We then optimize a bounded input perturbation to maximize the average deviation of these predictions from a clean-edit reference, encouraging the perturbation to disrupt multiple possible editing outcomes. Experiments on two image editors demonstrate substantial gains in protection performance, with SPIN outperforming compared methods across all six metrics under seen instructions and in the more challenging unseen instruction setting.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型极大地推动了基于指令的图像编辑，但也引发了对未经授权的图像篡改的担忧。 图像免疫通过在输入图像中添加不可察觉的扰动来破坏后续编辑，从而应对这一风险。 由于图像发布时编辑请求尚未知晓，因此保护机制应能超越构建扰动时所用的指令，持续有效。 现有的免疫方法要么需要代价高昂的全轨迹反向传播，要么使用中间目标，其效果可能因后续的降噪过程而减弱。 同时，单一推理路径对替代降噪路径提供的反馈十分有限。 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 SPIN——一种通过局部随机轨迹邻域进行单步投影的图像免疫框架。 SPIN 从早期降噪状态出发，在相同指令下生成随机的邻近状态，并通过单步投影预测其干净的潜在表示，而无需完整展开整个流程。 接着，我们优化一个有界输入扰动，以最大化这些预测与干净编辑参考之间的平均偏差，从而促使该扰动破坏多种可能的编辑结果。 在两种图像编辑器上进行的实验表明，SPIN 在保护性能方面取得了显著提升，在所有六个指标上均优于对比方法，无论是在已见指令还是在更具挑战性的未见指令设置中。

paragraphs.en: Instruction-guided diffusion models have made it possible to modify a source image using natural-language instructions while preserving content unrelated to the requested changes ( Brooks et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . Publicly available image editing models have substantially lowered the barriers to personalized image manipulation. However, the same accessibility also makes publicly released images vulnerable to unauthorized editing, which may compromise personal privacy and reputation or facilitate misleading content. Deepfake detection ( Rossler et al., 2019 ) and AI-generated image detection ( Ojha et al., 2023 ) can identify manipulated content, but operate only after such content has been produced. This motivates proactive protection that is embedded imperceptibly in images before release.

paragraphs.en: Image immunization protects source images by adding imperceptible perturbations that disrupt subsequent unauthorized edits. A direct approach optimizes perturbations against the final editing output, but backpropagation through the denoising trajectory incurs substantial computational cost ( Salman et al., 2023 ) . More efficient alternatives construct surrogate objectives from denoising predictions or intermediate representations ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Liang and Wu, 2023 ) . Such objectives can target encoder representations ( Xue et al., 2024 ) , instruction-related cross-attention ( Lo et al., 2024 ) , or early denoising states ( Choi et al., 2025 ) , providing protection signals through shorter gradient paths.
paragraphs.zh: 图像免疫通过在源图像中添加不可察觉的扰动来保护其免受后续未经授权的编辑。 一种直接方法针对最终的编辑输出优化扰动，但通过去噪轨迹进行反向传播会产生巨大的计算成本（Salman 等，2023）。 更高效的方法则是基于去噪预测或中间表示构建代理目标函数（Liang 等，2023；Liang 和 Wu，2023）。 这类目标函数可以针对编码器表示（Xue 等，2024）、与指令相关的交叉注意力（Lo 等，2024）或早期的去噪状态（Choi 等，2025），通过更短的梯度路径传递保护信号。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, deviations induced by intermediate representations may be attenuated by subsequent denoising, weakening their effect on the final edit. Protection under a fixed editing instruction may also depend on the specific sampling trajectory. This dependence becomes particularly relevant when future editing requests are unknown, as a single trajectory offers limited feedback about other possible continuations. The challenge is therefore to construct an effective optimization signal that reflects the perturbation’s impact on editing outcomes across multiple possible continuations, enabling protection beyond the original editing instruction.

paragraphs.en: We address this challenge by proposing SPIN (Single-step Projection in Stochastic Neighborhoods), an image-immunization framework that uses predicted editing outcomes to guide protective perturbations. Single-step projection predicts a clean latent from an early denoising state. The discrepancy between this prediction and a fixed clean-edit reference provides an effective surrogate for optimizing perturbations that disrupt the final editing output. To extend this signal beyond a single inference path, SPIN generates neighboring candidate states through stochastic transitions from a shared early state. We then optimize a bounded input perturbation to maximize the average discrepancy between their projected outcomes and the reference, reducing dependence on a single construction path and promoting generalization to unseen editing instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过提出 SPIN（随机邻域中的单步投影）来解决这一挑战。这是一种图像免疫框架，利用预测的编辑结果来指导保护性扰动。 单步投影从早期的去噪状态中预测一个干净的潜在表示。 该预测与固定干净的编辑参考之间的差异，为优化能够破坏最终编辑结果的扰动提供了一个有效的代理指标。 为了将这种信号扩展到单个推理路径之外，SPIN 通过从一个共享的早期状态进行随机转换，生成相邻的候选状态。 接着，我们优化一个有界输入扰动，以最大化其投影结果与参考之间的平均差异，从而减少对单一构建路径的依赖，并促进对未见编辑指令的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on SD3 and InstructPix2Pix show that SPIN outperforms all baselines across six metrics under both seen and unseen editing instructions. Immunization success rates reach 90% and 94% under seen instructions (85% and 91% under unseen instructions), consistently exceeding those of competing methods. Ablations demonstrate that single-step projection provides an effective protection signal, while stochastic neighborhood sampling further improves generalization over single-candidate projection.

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose SPIN , an image-immunization framework that uses single-step projection to guide perturbation optimization with predicted editing outcomes, providing an effective signal for disrupting the final edit.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SPIN，一种图像免疫框架，该框架利用单步投影，结合预测的编辑结果来引导扰动优化，从而为破坏最终编辑提供有效信号。

paragraphs.en: We introduce stochastic neighborhood optimization to construct a single perturbation that targets multiple possible continuations of the editing process. By driving their projected outcomes away from the clean-edit reference, this strategy promotes disruption across different inference paths and improves generalization to unseen editing instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入随机邻域优化方法，以构建一个单一扰动，该扰动针对编辑过程中多种可能的后续步骤。 通过将它们的预测结果从干净编辑的参考结果中偏离，这一策略促进了不同推理路径之间的干扰，并提升了对未见过的编辑指令的泛化能力。

sents.en: By driving their projected outcomes away from the clean-edit reference, this strategy promotes disruption across different inference paths and improves generalization to unseen editing instructions.
sents.zh: 通过将它们的预测结果从干净编辑的参考结果中偏离，这一策略促进了不同推理路径之间的干扰，并提升了对未见过的编辑指令的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Experiments under standard editing pipelines show that SPIN consistently outperforms the evaluated baselines in immunization success rate under both seen and unseen instructions, across flow-matching and noise-prediction diffusion editors.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准编辑流程下的实验表明，无论是在已见还是未见指令中，SPIN 在免疫成功率的性能上都持续优于所评估的基线模型，且这一优势体现在流匹配和噪声预测两种扩散编辑器中。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models support image editing by combining a generative prior with a source image and user-specified control. SDEdit ( Meng et al., 2022 ) perturbs and denoises an input through a stochastic differential equation to balance faithfulness and realism. Later methods introduced more explicit semantic control. Prompt-to-Prompt ( Hertz et al., 2023 ) manipulates cross-attention maps to preserve spatial layout while changing textual content, whereas Imagic ( Kawar et al., 2023 ) optimizes a text embedding and fine-tunes the model for semantic edits on a single image. InstructPix2Pix ( Brooks et al., 2023 ) establishes a supervised learning paradigm for directly following natural-language editing instructions without per-image inversion or fine-tuning. UltraEdit ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) advances this paradigm through large-scale editing supervision with diverse instructions, real-image anchors, and region annotations, supporting the adaptation of pretrained generative models, including Stable Diffusion 3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , to instruction-guided image editing. These advances improve the capability and accessibility of image editing, while also exposing publicly released images to increasingly diverse unauthorized transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型通过将生成先验知识与源图像及用户指定的控制条件相结合，支持图像编辑。 SDEdit（Meng 等人，2022）通过随机微分方程对输入进行扰动和去噪，以平衡忠实性与真实感。 后续方法引入了更明确的语义控制。 Prompt-to-Prompt（Hertz 等人，2023）通过操控交叉注意力图来改变文本内容同时保留空间布局，而 Imagic（Kawar 等人，2023）则优化文本嵌入并对模型进行微调，以实现单张图像的语义编辑。 InstructPix2Pix（Brooks 等人，2023）建立了一种监督学习范式，能够直接遵循自然语言编辑指令，无需针对每张图像进行反推或微调。 UltraEdit（Zhao 等人，2024）通过大规模编辑监督推动了这一范式的进步，其监督过程包含多样化指令、真实图像锚点和区域标注，从而支持将预训练生成模型（包括 Stable Diffusion 3（Esser 等人，2024））适配到指令引导的图像编辑任务中。 这些进展提升了图像编辑的能力与易用性，但同时也使公开发布的图像面临日益多样化且未经授权的变换风险。

sents.zh: InstructPix2Pix（Brooks 等人，2023）建立了一种监督学习范式，能够直接遵循自然语言编辑指令，无需针对每张图像进行反推或微调。

sents.en: UltraEdit ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) advances this paradigm through large-scale editing supervision with diverse instructions, real-image anchors, and region annotations, supporting the adaptation of pretrained generative models, including Stable Diffusion 3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , to instruction-guided image editing.
sents.zh: UltraEdit（Zhao 等人，2024）通过大规模编辑监督推动了这一范式的进步，其监督过程包含多样化指令、真实图像锚点和区域标注，从而支持将预训练生成模型（包括 Stable Diffusion 3（Esser 等人，2024））适配到指令引导的图像编辑任务中。

sents.en: These advances improve the capability and accessibility of image editing, while also exposing publicly released images to increasingly diverse unauthorized transformations.
sents.zh: 这些进展提升了图像编辑的能力与易用性，但同时也使公开发布的图像面临日益多样化且未经授权的变换风险。

paragraphs.en: Norm-bounded adversarial perturbations can alter model predictions ( Goodfellow et al., 2015 ) , and projected-gradient methods ( Madry et al., 2018 ) formulate their construction as constrained optimization. To improve cross-model transferability, MI-FGSM ( Dong et al., 2018 ) stabilizes updates through momentum, while VMI-FGSM ( Wang and He, 2021 ) further refines them using neighborhood gradient information. EOT ( Athalye et al., 2018 ) averages attack objectives over input transformations to improve transformation robustness, whereas universal adversarial perturbations generalize across images ( Moosavi-Dezfooli et al., 2017 ) . SPIN targets the generation trajectories of diffusion editors, optimizing a bounded input perturbation over local stochastic continuations to disrupt generation and drive final editing outputs away from their clean counterparts.
paragraphs.zh: 受范数约束的对抗性扰动可以改变模型预测（Goodfellow 等人，2015），而投影梯度方法（Madry 等人，2018）则将这种扰动的构造表述为带约束的优化问题。 为了提高跨模型迁移能力，MI-FGSM（Dong 等人，2018）通过动量来稳定更新过程，而 VMI-FGSM（Wang 和 He，2021）则进一步利用邻域梯度信息对这些更新进行优化。 EOT（Athalye 等人，2018）通过对输入变换进行平均来优化攻击目标，从而提升对变换的鲁棒性；而通用对抗性扰动则能够泛化到不同图像上（Moosavi-Dezfooli 等人，2017）。 SPIN 针对扩散编辑器的生成轨迹进行优化，通过对局部随机延续过程施加有界输入扰动，以破坏生成过程，并使最终的编辑结果偏离其原始干净版本。

paragraphs.en: Image immunization methods mainly differ in the optimization signal used to construct protective perturbations. PhotoGuard exposes the central trade-off through an efficient encoder-targeting objective (PhotoGuard-E) and a more output-related but expensive full-diffusion objective (PhotoGuard-D) ( Salman et al., 2023 ) . AdvDM optimizes the diffusion denoising loss, while MIST combines semantic and textural objectives to disrupt the generation process at multiple representation levels ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Liang and Wu, 2023 ) . Subsequent methods shorten the gradient path by targeting specific internal components: SDS ( Xue et al., 2024 ) applies score distillation at the vulnerable VAE bottleneck, EditShield ( Chen et al., 2024 ) shifts instruction-conditioned latent representations, and SA ( Lo et al., 2024 ) disrupts prompt-relevant cross-attention features. DiffusionGuard ( Choi et al., 2025 ) places its objective at early denoising stages. Other approaches improve complementary aspects of protection: DCT-Shield ( Bala et al., 2025 ) optimizes frequency-domain perturbations for visual fidelity and JPEG resistance, whereas SIFM ( Dong et al., 2025 ) combines intermediate-feature manipulation with semantic and perceptual criteria for evaluating edit failure. Despite their different targets, these methods either require costly differentiation through the diffusion trajectory or rely on internal surrogates whose deviations may be attenuated during subsequent denoising.
paragraphs.zh: 图像免疫方法主要区别在于用于构建保护性扰动所采用的优化信号。 PhotoGuard 通过一个高效的编码器靶向目标（PhotoGuard-E）和一个更关注输出但成本更高的完整扩散目标（PhotoGuard-D），揭示了其中的核心权衡（Salman 等，2023）。 AdvDM 优化了扩散去噪损失，而 MIST 则结合语义和纹理目标，在多个表示层面上干扰生成过程（Liang 等，2023；Liang 和 Wu，2023）。 后续方法通过靶向特定的内部组件来缩短梯度路径：SDS（Xue 等，2024）在易受攻击的 VAE 瓶颈处应用分数蒸馏，EditShield（Chen 等，2024）转移指令条件化的潜在表示，而 SA（Lo 等，2024）则干扰与提示相关的交叉注意力特征。 DiffusionGuard（Choi 等，2025）将其目标置于早期去噪阶段。 其他方法则改进了保护的互补方面：DCT-Shield（Bala 等，2025）优化了频域扰动以实现视觉保真度和 JPEG 抗性，而 SIFM（Dong 等，2025）则将中间特征操控与语义和感知标准相结合，以评估编辑失败。 尽管这些方法的目标各不相同，但它们要么需要通过扩散轨迹进行昂贵的微分，要么依赖内部代理变量，而这些代理变量的偏差可能在后续去噪过程中被削弱。

paragraphs.en: We present an image-immunization framework, termed Single-step Projection in Stochastic Neighborhoods ( SPIN ), for protecting images against unauthorized editing. To efficiently obtain a protection signal that reflects the perturbation’s effect on the predicted edit, we use single-step projection to estimate the clean latent from an intermediate denoising state. We further optimize the perturbation over a local stochastic neighborhood to reduce dependence on a single inference path and promote generalization across editing instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种名为“随机邻域中的单步投影”（SPIN）的图像免疫框架，用于保护图像免受未经授权的编辑。 为了高效地获得能够反映扰动对预测编辑影响的保护信号，我们使用单步投影从中间去噪状态中估计干净的潜在表示。 我们进一步在局部随机邻域内优化扰动，以减少对单一推理路径的依赖，并提升其在不同编辑指令下的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Our goal is to construct a bounded input perturbation that disrupts the final editing output and remains effective under unseen editing instructions. To this end, SPIN combines two modules, as shown in Figure 1 : (a) local trajectory sampling generates neighboring candidate states from a shared early state under a fixed construction instruction, providing feedback across multiple local continuations to reduce path dependence and support transfer to unseen instructions; (b) one-step projection estimates each candidate’s clean latent, enabling output-oriented evaluation without full sampling rollouts. We aggregate the projected candidates’ deviations from a fixed clean-edit reference to optimize the same input perturbation. The following subsections detail the projection, neighborhood construction, and perturbation optimization.

paragraphs.en: Different editing instructions induce different denoising trajectories. paragraphs.en: We construct a benchmark of 500 samples from Pico-Banana, covering landscapes, artworks, multi-object scenes, real-world photographs, news imagery, public figures, and indoor scenes. paragraphs.en: We evaluate InstructPix2Pix and Stable Diffusion 3 (SD3) as denoising-diffusion and flow-matching editors, respectively. We compare edits of clean and protected inputs using PSNR ( Wang and Bovik, 2009 ) , SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , FSIM ( Zhang et al., 2011 ) , VIFP ( Sheikh and Bovik, 2006 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . Lower values of the first four and higher LPIPS indicate stronger protection; the directions reverse for perturbation imperceptibility. Following SIFM ( Dong et al., 2025 ) , we report Immunization Success Rate (ISR): the fraction of protected edits with instruction failure or substantial perceptual degradation, judged by consensus of Kimi K2.5 ( Team et al., 2026 ) and Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . Higher ISR indicates stronger protection. See Appendices A.2 and D for evaluation details.

paragraphs.en: We first compare SPIN with representative image-immunization methods, PhotoGuard-E/PhotoGuard-D ( Salman et al., 2023 ) , SDS ( Xue et al., 2024 ) , ED ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , AdvDM ( Liang et al., 2023 ) , MIST ( Liang and Wu, 2023 ) , SA ( Lo et al., 2024 ) , DCT ( Bala et al., 2025 ) , and SIFM ( Dong et al., 2025 ) on SD3 and InstructPix2Pix under the instructions used to construct the protected inputs. Table 1 shows that SPIN achieves the greatest output discrepancy and highest immunization success rate on both editors. Compared with objectives defined on intermediate features or noisy states, our projection objective targets deviations in predicted editing outcomes, aligning perturbation optimization more closely with final-edit disruption and thereby improving immunization performance.

paragraphs.en: Protection quality also depends on input fidelity and perturbation-generation cost. We measure fidelity between clean and protected images separately from output discrepancy. All efficiency measurements are conducted on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 GPU, using the same input resolution and optimization budgets across methods. As shown in Table 3 , SPIN achieves better perturbation imperceptibility on most reported metrics and the highest immunization success rate, with a reasonable generation time per image.

paragraphs.en: We measure latent discrepancy using the cosine distance between flattened latent representations. Table 4 reports this distance between the final latents of clean and protected edits after full denoising, alongside output PSNR and LPIPS. Under the same perturbation budget, one-step projection yields substantially larger latent cosine distances, lower PSNR, and higher LPIPS than random perturbations, demonstrating its effectiveness as a surrogate for disrupting final editing outputs. Compared with single-candidate projection, SPIN ( K = 4 K=4 ) further improves all three metrics on both editors under the same PGD budget, demonstrating the benefit of aggregating feedback across stochastic local continuations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用扁平化潜在表示之间的余弦距离来衡量潜在差异。 表 4 报告了完全去噪后，干净编辑和保护性编辑的最终潜在表示之间的这一距离，以及输出的 PSNR 和 LPIPS。 在相同的扰动预算下，单步投影产生的潜在余弦距离明显更大，PSNR 更低，LPIPS 更高，优于随机扰动，这表明它作为破坏最终编辑输出的替代方法具有有效性。 与单候选投影相比，SPIN（K = 4）在相同 PGD 预算下进一步提升了两种编辑器在所有三项指标上的表现，证明了聚合随机局部延续中的反馈所带来的益处。

paragraphs.en: We vary the branch position to examine candidate diversity and final-output deviation, and separately vary the timing of projection-guided latent updates that steer the trajectory away from the clean edit. Figure 4 (a) shows that later branching improves projection accuracy but reduces variation among candidate projections and their final deviations from the clean edit. Figure 4 (b) further shows that earlier latent updates produce larger final latent cosine distances and lower output PSNR, indicating stronger trajectory disruption. These observations motivate early branching and projection in SPIN .

paragraphs.en: We introduced SPIN to protect images against unauthorized editing by jointly considering the predicted outcomes of multiple local editing trajectories. This formulation makes output-oriented protection tractable without differentiating through the full denoising process. It also allows a protective perturbation to account for alternative continuations of an edit, rather than relying on a single construction path. Together, these ideas offer a practical direction for image immunization when future editing requests are unknown at the time of image release.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过联合考虑多个局部编辑轨迹的预测结果，引入了 SPIN 来保护图像免受未经授权的编辑。 这种表述使得以输出为导向的保护变得可行，而无需对整个去噪过程进行求导。 它还允许保护性扰动考虑到编辑的多种替代延续方式，而不是仅仅依赖单一的构建路径。 综合来看，这些思路为图像免疫提供了一种实用方向，尤其是在图像发布时无法预知未来编辑请求的情况下。

paragraphs.en: This work studies image immunization against unauthorized instruction-guided image editing. Although our method employs adversarial attacks, its objective is defensive: to help image owners protect their content by applying bounded perturbations before publication, reducing the risk of unwanted manipulation. The method operates on input images while keeping the editing models frozen. The same perturbation mechanism could also be used to disrupt legitimate editing workflows. We therefore encourage its use on images that users own or are authorized to protect. Our experiments use images from Pico-Banana, and the edited examples serve to evaluate protection effectiveness. They should not be interpreted as authentic depictions of people or events.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨了针对未经授权、由指令引导的图像编辑的图像免疫方法。 尽管我们的方法采用了对抗性攻击，但其目标是防御性的：通过在发布前施加有界扰动，帮助图像所有者保护其内容，从而降低被恶意篡改的风险。 该方法对输入图像进行操作，同时保持编辑模型固定不变。 同样的扰动机制也可能被用来破坏合法的编辑流程。 因此，我们建议用户仅在对拥有所有权或获得授权保护的图像上使用该方法。 我们的实验使用了来自 Pico-Banana 的图像，而经过编辑的示例用于评估保护效果。 这些示例不应被解读为对人物或事件的真实描绘。
